summary: Iteration 63 - Turkish Payment Gateway (iyzico & PayTR) testing complete. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all Turkish payment features working correctly in demo/sandbox mode.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Turkish Payment Gateway feature fully tested. iyzico and PayTR virtual checkout flows working in demo/sandbox mode. When real API keys are configured, they redirect to actual payment provider pages.

backend_apis: POST /api/payments/iyzico-checkout - Creates iyzico checkout session, returns demo URL with token ✓
POST /api/payments/paytr-checkout - Creates PayTR checkout session, returns demo URL with token ✓
POST /api/payments/turkish-demo-confirm - Confirms demo payment, marks booking as paid ✓
POST /api/payments/iyzico-callback - Callback endpoint exists and responds ✓
POST /api/payments/paytr-callback - Callback endpoint exists and responds ✓
Invalid booking returns 404 for both providers ✓
Transaction records created with correct payment_method (iyzico/paytr) ✓
frontend_pages: Booking Engine /book?property=aldgate-flats - Shows 4 payment options (Stripe, iyzico, PayTR, Pay at Hotel) ✓
Payment options show Turkish text: 'iyzico ile Ode', 'PayTR ile Ode' ✓
Selecting iyzico changes button to 'iyzico ile {amount} GBP Ode' ✓
Selecting PayTR changes button to 'PayTR ile {amount} GBP Ode' ✓
Turkish Pay Page /turkish-pay?provider=iyzico - iyzico branded checkout with purple gradient ✓
Turkish Pay Page /turkish-pay?provider=paytr - PayTR branded checkout with red gradient ✓
Installment options (Tek Cekim, 2/3/6/9/12 Taksit) with monthly amounts ✓
Supported Turkish banks displayed (Garanti BBVA, Yapı Kredi, İş Bankası, etc.) ✓
3D Secure badge and trust indicators visible ✓
3D Secure verification screen shown during payment processing ✓
Success page shows 'Odeme Basarili!' with booking details ✓
Payment Gateway dashboard accessible with Transactions tab ✓

mocked_apis.iyzico: Demo/sandbox mode - no real API keys configured. Redirects to /turkish-pay demo page
mocked_apis.PayTR: Demo/sandbox mode - no real API keys configured. Redirects to /turkish-pay demo page
mocked_apis.note: With real iyzico/PayTR API credentials, the checkout endpoints redirect to actual Turkish bank payment pages
